subject.title: Issue: The desktop widget appears to have a rectangular background box

question: Should CodexBar’s desktop widgets keep the current tertiary container background, or should they render transparently by default?
rationale: Current source intentionally requests a widget container fill, while the issue asks to change that visual policy; code inspection alone cannot determine the intended cross-appearance design.

options.title: Keep the current container fill
options.body: Retain the existing tertiary background as the supported legibility treatment and close the request with that design rationale.

options.title: Make widgets transparent by default
options.body: Remove or replace the tertiary widget container fill and validate the resulting contrast in light and dark appearances.

options.title: Offer an appearance preference
options.body: Add a user-selectable widget background treatment if both opaque and transparent appearances are intended to remain supported.

recommendation.title: Make widgets transparent by default
recommendation.body: Remove or replace the tertiary widget container fill and validate the resulting contrast in light and dark appearances.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership is the only available reliable routing signal for this product-level widget appearance decision.
